# Camp Resource: The Whril Whizard Paint Can Generator

Time to repaint the C.A.M.P. make sure you are well prepared!

Generates Paint Cans.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__The Whril Whizard Paint Can Generator__

**Produces**

Scrap the paint cans for junk or put them in display cases

- Red Paint
 - 5x Lead
 - 2x Oil
 - 2x Steel
- Blue Paint
 - 5x Lead
 - 2x Oil
 - 2x Steel
- Empty Paint Can
 - 2x Steel
- Paint Can
 - 5x Lead
 - 2x Oil
 - 2x Steel
- Yellow Paint
 - 5x Lead
 - 2x Oil
 - 2x Steel

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

3x Steel

**Holds**

6 Pounds

Paint Cans weigh between 0.5 pounds to 3 pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

3 power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
